# 1.37.0-beta.4

Fourth beta of 1.37.0: documents, voice and media.

## PowerPoint

- The chat now makes PowerPoint presentations. Every heading becomes a slide with its title; lists, tables, pictures and speaker notes land where they belong, and the font size follows the amount of text so nothing runs off the slide.
- Existing presentations are changed slide by slide: replace text on every slide and in the notes, insert, replace or delete slides by the numbers the chat read, or add slides at the end. New slides take the layouts and look of the presentation they go into.

## Tables and charts

- Ask about a CSV or Excel table and the chat filters, groups and totals it over every row of the file instead of adding numbers up itself. Numbers are read the way people write them, with spaces between thousands, a decimal comma, percent and currency signs.
- Charts appear right in the answer: bars, lines or a pie, drawn in the colors of your theme, with the value under the pointer.
- Real Excel charts can be added to a workbook. They point at the cells, so the chart follows when the table changes.

## Text recognition

- Text in a picture or in a scanned PDF is read on this computer with the text recognition built into Windows, without the internet. Scans without a text layer no longer come back empty.

## Voice

- Answers can be read aloud with the speaker button under them; a second click stops it. Settings > General > Voice input, under Reading aloud, picks what reads: Windows on this PC or a speech model of Venice or OpenRouter, with its voice and speed.
- Voice input works in Russian and other languages Windows cannot recognize: with a Venice or OpenRouter key, Auto uses Whisper Large V3 in the cloud, so the microphone appears without any setup. Cloud models and speech languages are now picked from lists, and a line under Recognition says what recognizes your speech right now or why nothing can.

## Recordings and video

- Attach a meeting recording or a video (MP3, M4A, WAV, WMA, FLAC, MP4, MOV, WMV, AVI) and it is transcribed right away with the same engine as voice input, then attached as text with time marks, ready for minutes. The audio itself is not stored in the chat.

## Screenshots

- A new shortcut that works from any app takes a screenshot of a selected area and attaches it to the open chat. Set it in Settings > General > Keyboard shortcuts, under From any app.
